nodes.label: Clean Architecture Layers (api/application/domain/infrastructure)
nodes.rationale: Separates HTTP routing (api/) from use-case logic (application/), pure business rules (domain/) and adapters (infrastructure/) so that no framework dependency contaminates domain code.

nodes.label: Redis Snapshot-Validated Read Model
nodes.rationale: Reads pg_current_snapshot() before each cache lookup so a committed write changes snapshot visibility even if the process loses Redis. Booking/availability payloads are never cached; cache keys use read-model:v2:<snapshot hash>:<Redis epoch>:<key>.

nodes.label: Booking and Availability in Postgres Only
nodes.rationale: Concurrent slot allocation requires database-level consistency. Python must not insert directly into bookings/booking_services or calculate available slots; only create_booking() and get_available_slots() Postgres functions are authorised.

hyperedges.label: Booking Creation Idempotency Pattern (Postgres + Redis + use cases)
